summary: Delivery1051 preserves OPS-TYPED-01.3/.4 at the live FourD native-image entrypoint after the old Coordination workflow retirement. Source mapping distinguishes FourD source, Coordination acquisition-producer and P2 source identities. Existing Join/RunObservation target the retired workflow; their 2700-second operation protocol cannot silently replace the native90-minute window. Root owns selection of a compatible native-profile lifecycle without renewing aggregate budgets. The new qualification-local validate-native-source command constructs a validated snapshot by joining packet expectations and Git revision/tree observations with the complete acquired directory inventory, using the existing UTF-8 path-NUL-bytes-NUL algorithm. Its bounded Linux held-descriptor reader refuses links, nonregular files and oversized inputs. This stateless constructor and its source-only CI prepare integration; they establish no producer publication, packet custody, consumer activation, protected reservation, encrypted transport, native acceptance, cleanup/credential retirement or Python retirement. Revalidate acquired bytes at consumption; earlier validation is not an immutable handoff. Delivery1051 keeps its full promise and original attempts.
title: FourD native reconstructed source needs independent producer and lifecycle joins
